translations.web: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
translations.bsb: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
translations.kjv: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
translations.asv: All that which the Father giveth me shall come unto me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
